sigil.anchor.name: anchor
sigil.anchor.notes: PLACEHOLDER sigil. Replace with your real central sigil. A sigil names what the expression is about; it sits in the centre layer.

sigil.beacon.name: beacon
sigil.beacon.notes: PLACEHOLDER second sigil so you can test choosing between two central sigils. Replace or delete.

sign.push.name: push
sign.push.notes: PLACEHOLDER sign. Orientation is read intrinsically: angle 0 = pointing at the ring centre, 90 = along the ring. Flip-ambiguous shapes render both readings until you declare chirality.

sign.carry.name: carry
sign.carry.notes: PLACEHOLDER sign occupying the diagonal sectors, so you can test slot assignment against push. Replace with your real language.
